title: Senior Consultant, .Net
announcement: At Ensono, our purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation. Developing impactful solutions is something we do together at Ensono because Ideas Start Here. Great things happen when many voices are heard, and people are supported to run with their ideas. On our teams, you will be backed by leaders with a passion for our business. This is a place where your ideas can Do Great Things. We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. Adventure starts here. Here you will be a part of a team that encourages you to master your craft, ask tomorrow's questions today, and chart your path. Our Associates focus on client impact with curiosity and a feeling of relentless commitment. About the role and what you will be doing: As a Senior .NET Consultant at Ensono Digital, you will play a key delivery and technical leadership role within your project, operating as a trusted senior engineer who supports high-quality outcomes while helping the team and client realise the business value of their cloud investment. You will typically support a Tech Lead or Lead Consultant, taking ownership of significant technical areas or sub-systems within a larger solution. Working across the full project lifecycle, you will collaborate closely with Ensono Digital colleagues and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear technical designs and deliver modern, cloud-native solutions using contemporary engineering practices. Beyond project delivery, you will contribute to Ensono Digital communities, share knowledge, and continuously develop your skills and career as a senior consultant.   What you’ll bring to Ensono Digital   We are looking for experienced senior engineers who bring strong technical capability, sound judgment, and a collaborative mindset. You will have experience delivering production ‑ grade systems and taking ownership of technical outcomes within complex projects.   You will bring experience and capability in areas such as:   Developing high ‑ quality solutions using .NET (Core / modern .NET) Building and operating systems on cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS Working with microservice and distributed architectures, understanding their benefits and trade‑ offs Translating business requirements into well‑ defined designs and sub ‑ system architectures Writing appropriate integration and end‑ to ‑ end tests, using approaches such as BDD where appropriate Maintaining accountability for code quality, security, and engineering standards   You will demonstrate strong technical communication and problem ‑ solving skills, including:   Clearly explaining the purpose of a solution and the reasoning behind design and technology choices to both technical and non ‑ technical stakeholders Confidently resolving technical challenges within a complex delivery and taking responsibility for outcomes within your scope Contributing constructively to architectural discussions, discovery activities, and design reviews   You will also bring a modern developer mindset, including: Working effectively with AI ‑ assisted development tools to support productivity and learning, while applying professional judgment and remaining accountable for results Valuing clear specifications, documentation, and fast feedback loops as enablers of sustainable delivery Continuously improving your own skills and supporting the growth of others through collaboration and knowledge sharing   Above all, you will bring a professional, proactive approach, strong collaboration skills, and a genuine interest in delivering high ‑ quality outcomes for clients while growing as a senior consultant within Ensono Digital.   Our benefits include   Highly competitive salary Prestigious sales and broader team recognition with Annual
